clauses.quote: If there are more than fifty (50) participants in any intramural program, an additional coach may be added.
clauses.notes: Conditional entitlement to an extra coaching position based on participant count.

clauses.quote: Should the number of participants drop below fifty-one (51) at any time prior to three (3) weeks before the close of the season, the assignment shall be terminated
clauses.notes: Management duty to terminate under-enrolled coaching programs.
Verbatim lacks modal but contextually implies 'shall be' prorated pay.

clauses.quote: The rate of weekly compensation for intermediate coaches listed below will be determined by dividing the appropriate percent of Class III, Step 7 of the salary schedule by 11.
clauses.subject_text: The rate of weekly compensation for intermediate coaches listed below
clauses.notes: Mandates the mathematical formula for calculating stipend rates.

clauses.quote: All coaches will be paid for the recognized length of the season of the sport coached.
Three (3) or more days of practice/competition per week during spring or winter recess will be considered as one (1) week.
clauses.subject_text: Three (3) or more days of practice/competition per week during spring or winter recess
clauses.notes: Defines credit accrual rules for pay calculation.
